summary: Phase 135D.1: Metadata-Repair Incident Investigation and Staleness Guard. Investigated the pcae phase metadata-repair phase_id corruption disclosed during 135D's own finalization, in docs/PHASE_135D.1_METADATA_REPAIR_INCIDENT_INVESTIGATION.md. Root-caused it to .pcae/phase-completion-report.md, a separate tracked hand-authored file never updated past an earlier phase across three subsequent phases -- not the Architecture Status generation mechanism a prior real-time assumption had blamed. Proved via exact timestamps that the rewrite occurred after certification, promotion, and Telegram dispatch, and never touched the promoted report, marker, or delivery payload -- all correctly and exclusively named the current phase throughout. Tested and rejected a mixed-generation latest.md/latest.json hypothesis. Traced the --allow-partial-report override precisely and confirmed it cannot mask a genuine cross-source phase-identity disagreement, only the completeness/trust dimension. Classification: A -- certified evidence internally correct, only the terminal report's trust/completeness derivation was affected. Corrected the stale canonical narrative file and added a staleness guard to run_phase_metadata_repair() in src/pcae/commands/phase.py that refuses to overwrite metadata when the canonical report disagrees with PROJECT_STATUS.md's own current phase and metadata already agrees with it. Added 3 regression tests to tests/test_finalization_configuration_identity_cross_agent_134b3.py.
